symptom: `base64Encode(…)` (not a Mendix function) in a `call rest service` header value, and a made-up function in its body or URL, passed check and exec; mx check reported CE0117 at the Call REST service activity, while the same call in a declare was refused as MDL044.
file: mdl/executor/validate_microflow.go checkStmtExprFunctions (RestCallStmt: URL, URL template params, headers, auth, body, body template params, timeout). Test: mdl/executor/rest_call_expr_functions_2408_test.go
cause: checkStmtExprFunctions is the single list of expression sites MDL044 walks, and RestCallStmt was not in it.
insight: **A single list of expression sites is only as complete as its last statement type.** #1033 (nanoflows), #2199 (show message) and now the REST call were each the same omission; when a statement grows expression fields, add it to checkStmtExprFunctions in the same change.
